svg.title: Merkle tree over the 32 fragment slots of a group
svg.desc: A Merkle tree over 32 fragment slots at default settings: 16 data, 8 guaranteed parity and 8 extra parity fragments. The proof for fragment 19 is the five sibling hashes of leaf 18 and of the nodes covering slots 16 to 17, 20 to 23, 24 to 31 and 0 to 15; with them a verifier recomputes the path to the signed root.
svg.text: Merkle tree over the 32 fragment slots of a group
Proof for fragment 19: 5 sibling hashes, 160 bytes, lead from its leaf to the root signed in the group descriptor
leaf i = SHA-256(00 ‖ u8 i ‖ fragment data)
padding leaf = SHA-256(02), unused at 32 slots
